The Hebrew and English text appears structurally correct and legible. The Arabic script, however, shows slight inconsistencies in character connectivity and baseline alignment compared to native typography, suggesting potential AI rendering imperfections.

The area where the signs attach to the poles lacks distinct mechanical hardware (bolts/clamps). The geometry merges slightly, which is a common subtle AI artifact where complex small parts fail to resolve cleanly.
